headline: Canada and Turkey Sign Strategic Partnership to Broaden Trade Ties
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan signed a bilateral strategic partnership in Ankara aimed at diversifying Canadian trade and reducing reliance on the US.
why: Trade diversification initiatives by G7 economies aim to mitigate exposure to tariff volatility and single-market supply dependencies.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Broader commercial agreements support alternative export market access for Canadian exporters.
